text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0845 CDT.

CANOLA - C$2.00 to C$1.00 lower with old crop expected to show most substantial losses. Hedge-related selling likely early following strong close on Friday. Forecasts for a lower opening on CBOT soybeans should also weigh on the market. July WCE futures crush profit margin fell to -10.42 Friday from -10.06 Thursday. Canada's dollar was weaker at C$1.3981 versus the U.S. dollar but rose against the yen to 90.50.
FLAX - C$0.50 to C$1.00 lower on pickup in producer offerings and spillover weakness from other oilseed markets. Commission house short covering should help to limit losses.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.60 to C$0.10 lower with May expected to show greatest losses as longs seen continuing to liquidate ahead of Wednesday's first notice day.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.30 to C$0.50 lower on lower CBOT grain calls. Commission house and commercial short covering on the May contract should help to underpin values.
PEAS - US$0.50 lower to steady. May seen lower as commercials liquidate longs with July steady on commercial demand.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
